official: 東京都が東京信用保証協会に対し交付する補助金に係る回収納付金を受け取る権利の放棄に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会 提出議案と議決結果

name: 回収納付金を受け取る権利の放棄対象を追加
summary: 東京都が東京信用保証協会から回収納付金を受け取る権利については、放棄できる場合が条例で定められています。この議案では、協会が権利変更案に同意しようとする早期事業再生計画に基づく場合も、放棄できるようにします。この変更は2026年12月11日から、条項番号の修正は公布の日から施行されます。
changes: 協会が権利変更案に同意しようとする早期事業再生計画に基づく場合も、都が回収納付金を受け取る権利を放棄できるようにする
条例中で引用する条項番号を改める
who: 早期事業再生計画の対象となる事業者
why: 事業者の債務を調整する手続きを定めた法律の施行を踏まえ、権利放棄の規定などを改める必要があるためと、都は説明しています。

en.name: Adds another case in which the right to receive recovery payments may be waived
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Waiver of the Right to Receive Recovery Payments Related to Grants Provided by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government to the Tokyo Credit Guarantee Association
en.summary: The ordinance sets out the cases in which the Tokyo Metropolitan Government may waive its right to receive recovery payments from the Tokyo Credit Guarantee Association. This bill would also allow the right to be waived in cases based on an early business revitalization plan to which the association intends to agree to a proposed change in rights. This change will take effect on December 11, 2026, and the correction of the article numbers will take effect on the day the ordinance is promulgated.
changes: Allows the Tokyo Metropolitan Government to waive its right to receive recovery payments in cases based on an early business revitalization plan to which the association intends to agree to a proposed change in rights
Revises the article numbers cited in the ordinance
who: Businesses covered by early business revitalization plans
en.why: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government says that the provisions on waiving the right, among other things, need to be revised in light of the enforcement of a law setting out procedures for adjusting businesses’ debts.
